fun_facts: Mason Bonner’s recruiting profile lists Denver, Colorado, as his hometown.
He played high school football at J. K. Mullen High School.
At Michigan, he was listed as a 6-foot-7 freshman tight end wearing No. 18.
Against No. 4 UCLA, Bonner caught a 6-yard touchdown pass from Bryce Underwood. Michigan went on to win 18–16 in triple overtime.

His ESPN player bio gives his freshman status, tight end position, height, and jersey number. ESPN’s UCLA game entry identifies his 6-yard touchdown and Michigan’s triple-overtime win over No. 4 UCLA.
